chunks: I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A camel has fallen into a well; how can it be slaughtered? He said: Insert the spear and stab it with it, and say the name (Bismillah), and eat.

key_terms.تَرَدَّى: fell/tumbled down (into a pit or well)
key_terms.يُسَمِّي: to pronounce the name of God (saying Bismillah) before slaughter
key_terms.يُنْحَرُ: to be slaughtered by stabbing at the base of the neck (nahr — the method for camels)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for slaughtering a camel that has fallen into a well according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a practical jurisprudential question: what to do when a camel falls into a well and cannot be slaughtered in the standard manner (by cutting the throat). Imam al-Sadiq (AS) rules that in such an emergency, one may insert a spear or lance into the camel and wound it fatally while pronouncing the name of God (Bismillah), making the meat permissible (halal) to eat. This ruling reflects the Islamic principle that necessity (darura) permits alternative methods when normal slaughter (dhabh or nahr) is impossible.
